added_lines: Amazon Bedrock global versus regional endpoints for Opus 4.7, Haiku 4.5, and later models, or the legacy integration for all other models on Bedrock

Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed) offers global endpoints and multi-region endpoints (dynamic routing within a geographic area) for these models, and regional endpoints for Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier models.
Claude models are available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed). For official pricing, visit:
Credit card and invoicing options are available.
Standard usage tiers use the pricing shown in Model pricing.

This applies to the Claude API (first-party), Claude Platform on AWS, and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed). On Claude in Microsoft Foundry, the same 1.1x multiplier applies to deployments that use the US Data Zone Standard deployment type (see Inference geography). Partner-operated platforms, Bedrock and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed), have independent regional pricing. See Bedrock pricing and Google Cloud pricing for details. Earlier models do not support the inference_geo parameter and always use standard pricing; requests that include the parameter on these models return a 400 error.

This section covers partner-operated cloud platforms, where the cloud provider invoices you. For Anthropic-operated cloud platforms billed through a marketplace, see Claude Platform on AWS pricing, Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) billing, and Claude in Microsoft Foundry pricing.
Usage tracking is available in the Claude Console at platform.claude.com.

Web search is available on the Claude API for $10 USD per 1,000 searches, plus standard token costs for search-generated content. Web search results retrieved throughout a conversation are counted as input tokens, in search iterations run during a single turn and in subsequent conversation turns.
| CCU price | $0.01 USD per CCU (fixed; discounts apply at token-to-CCU conversion, not to the CCU price)
| Conversion | Token usage rated in USD at standard per-model, per-feature rates (same as Claude API pricing), then converted to CCUs at $0.01 USD per CCU
| Session runtime | $0.08 USD per session-hour | running status duration
